Crafting this item requires a total of 25,000 progress; 7,500 at the drafting table and 17,500 at the tailor's dummy (as an unfinished masterwork magic boots). At the default rate of 20 progress every 4 ticks (2.4 seconds), this takes 5000 ticks, or 50 minutes. This time may be increased or decreased by interacting with focus windows.

sc: Percy is a pet that could be obtained by handing in 10,000 charity tokens during the Mental Health Awareness Week (2018-2020) event.

The name of the item comes from the tales about phoenixes.

Players can obtain this item by using a hot kettle with a gold-trimmed teapot with leaves.
Complete directions on how to make tea can be found here.
